display_long_description:
Arrow Escape: Puzzle Challenge is a relaxing yet challenging logic puzzle game designed for immersive play.
Your goal is simple: free every arrow from the grid.
But solving each puzzle requires careful thinking, planning, and strategy.

Every arrow points in a direction and can only escape if the path ahead is clear. One wrong move can block the grid and make the puzzle harder to solve. Think ahead, analyze the layout, and clear the board step by step.

With 600 + handcrafted levels, the game gradually introduces more complex puzzle layouts that will test your logic and problem-solving skills.

Key Features:
• 600+ handcrafted puzzle levels
• Strategic arrow escape mechanics
• Hint system to help solve difficult puzzles
• Grid assist for better puzzle planning
• Progressive difficulty and brain-teasing challenges
• Relaxing yet challenging gameplay
